name: Sheleph
title: Descendant of Canaan
summary: Sheleph was one of the sons of Joktan, who was a descendant of Shem, Noah's son. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the early peoples on the Arabian Peninsula. Sheleph represents one of the many nations that arose after the Tower of Babel and the scattering of the peoples.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Shem's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Sheleph is listed as one of Joktan's thirteen sons in the post-flood genealogy that describes the origins of the nations.

keyEvents.title: Origins of the Nations
keyEvents.description: In the overview of the dispersion of the nations after the flood, Sheleph is mentioned as part of Joktan's lineage who settled in the eastern mountain regions.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sheleph's place in the genealogy is confirmed in 1 Chronicles, which repeats the family tree from Genesis to connect Israel's history with the beginning of the world.

keyEvents.title: Joktan's Lineage in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The entire list of Joktan's sons, including Sheleph, is reproduced in the opening chapter of Chronicles as part of humanity's complete family history.
